📰 Elliptic: Binance Hackers Convert $124 Million into BTC; $2.85 Billion in Stolen Funds Remains Frozen—Why Is Recovery So Difficult This Time?

A new report from cryptocurrency security firm Elliptic shows that tokens worth $124 million stolen in last year’s Binance hack have been converted into Bitcoin, but the huge sum does not appear to have been cashed out into fiat currency yet. More concerning, the remaining $2.85 billion in crypto assets still cannot be moved. The incident once again highlights the enormous challenges of recovering blockchain assets.

Why does this news matter?
Elliptic’s tracking shows that the hackers have been gradually dispersing the stolen funds across multiple wallets through anonymous transactions on darknet markets. Notably, most of the stolen assets are still circulating within the crypto ecosystem, suggesting that the hackers are waiting for a more favorable time to cash out or looking for more discreet ways to convert the funds. This reflects two persistent pain points in the industry:
1. Blockchain recovery mechanisms are inefficient, with a lack of effective cross-platform tracing tools.
2. Compliance gaps remain in crypto cash-out channels, while regulators struggle to coordinate oversight of darknet trading platforms.
This phenomenon of “stolen assets neither disappearing nor going away” resembles the movement of funds following the 2020 Coinbase hack, suggesting that the security systems of major exchanges still have vulnerabilities that can be exploited.

Market impact
In terms of market sentiment, news like this could heighten investors’ concerns about exchange security. Although BTC and ETH have been relatively unaffected in the short term (currently trading at $75.87K and $2.238K, respectively), if regulatory measures fail to improve recovery rates, regulators may introduce stricter anti-money-laundering rules over the longer term. As for fund flows, demand to cash out smaller-cap coins may increase, but there has been no significant overall outflow of funds.

Trading outlook
💡 For now, the short-term sentiment impact on ETH ($2.238K) appears greater, as the BTC ($75.87K) used by the hackers is more valuable, but event-driven selling pressure across the broader market remains limited. A chain reaction would only be triggered if an exchange were forced to suspend withdrawals because of a similar incident in the future.

Elliptic的追踪显示，黑客通过在暗网市场匿名交易，将赃款缓慢分散到多个钱包。值得注意的是，这些被盗资产大部分仍停留在加密世界内部流转，说明黑客在等待更有利的套现时机或正在寻找更隐蔽的变现方式。这背后反映了两个行业痛点：

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | More Important Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own performance. They've got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your rationale), what went right or wrong (in terms of execution),
and what you'll do differently next time (specific actions). Stick with it for a month, and you'll be shocked to discover: your losses
The same types of mistakes keep showing up in your trades—for example, always reversing your position right after a stop-loss,
or never holding on to winning trades.

The market changes, but your behavior patterns won't change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don't just look at your account balance—review your trading records.

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | Five Rules I Keep Beside My Screen—Sharing Them Just as They Are Today
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, people forget every lesson, so I wrote these down and stuck them up where I can see them:

1. Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t, don’t enter.
2. Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
3. Never add to a losing position or average down.
4. After three losing trades in a row, stop trading for the day. Just watch—don’t trade.
5. Withdraw part of your profits. The money you take out is cash; what you leave behind is peace of mind.

That’s all five rules—not one of them is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they misread the market; it’s that their execution breaks down. Let’s keep each other accountable.

title: EL SÍNDROME DE BARTLEBY: POR QUÉ EL TRADING ALGORITMICO ME DEVOLVIÓ EL CONTROL
subTitle:
Durante años fui el Bartleby de Melville. No porque me negara a trabajar, sino por esa inutilidad esencial de desgastarte en un sistema que no valora tu conocimiento y te reemplaza por alguien más joven en cuanto puede. Esa dinámica termina el día que decides tomar el control de cómo quieres pasar el resto de tu vida haciendo dinero.
Estaba en la jaula de un trabajo ordinario de 8 a 6, sintiendo cómo un sistema gris me devoraba lentamente. Cuando decidí dar el salto hacia el trading —bajo mi alter ego, Bookbinder— no lo hice persiguiendo la promesa del dinero fácil. 
Lo hice por el verdadero sueño latinoamericano: soberanía absoluta. Quería trabajar a solas, desde cualquier lugar, sin jefes, sin horarios impuestos y sin burocracias rancias dictándome cómo o cuándo recibir mi dinero
Al principio, caí en la misma trampa que todos. Estudié velas, indicadores, patrones, ciclos de mercado y psicología. Tenía decenas de piezas sueltas en la mesa, pero nadie te enseña cómo engranarlas en un método real. El marketing tradicional del trading te convence de que el problema eres tú: te dicen que tu cerebro animal te sabotea, que te falta disciplina o que un simple stop loss es tu salvavidas.
Pero esa era apenas la punta del iceberg.
Al vivir con neurodivergencia, mi cerebro no procesa las matemáticas de forma convencional; el espacio y el tiempo no se mueven en un plano cartesiano lineal dentro de mi cabeza. Intentar hacer trading manual (discrecional) frente a una pantalla en vivo era una tortura. Me di cuenta de que operar así es como ser un mecánico aficionado intentando reparar un auto con alambres mientras compites en la Fórmula 1 contra grandes instituciones, fondos y algoritmos de Inteligencia Artificial.
Ahí entendí una verdad que casi nadie debate en público: el trading sistemático es la única forma de sobrevivir sin destruir tu salud mental.
Cuando traduces tus ideas a reglas estrictas y las sometes a algoritmos, eliminas la necesidad de tomar decisiones en caliente. Pero al dar ese paso, choqué contra las dos grandes paredes de este negocio:
1.La falta de un método científico para validar si una idea realmente funciona. El trabajo aburrido, largo y agotador de probar reglas hasta encontrar una ventaja estadística real (edge).
2.La mayoría pierde años buscando estrategias complejas o copiando sistemas ajenos que nunca se adaptan a su realidad. No se trataba de adivinar el futuro, sino de construir tus propias reglas operativas y pasarlas por un filtro matemático SIN EMOCIONES que te diga la verdad antes de arriesgar tu pellejo: ¿Esto tiene probabilidad de sobrevivir en el tiempo, o te va a arruinar?
Toda esta búsqueda tiene un costo altísimo: operativo, mental y físico. Y seamos honestos: a medida que pasa el tiempo, dispones de menos años para lograr ser rentable. La rentabilidad exige tiempo y capital, y no todos pueden darse el lujo de pasar cinco años aprendiendo programación y estadística desde cero para luego crear la experiencia que finalmente te dirá si puedes dejar tu trabajo de 6 a 8.
Por eso decidí convertir mi propio dolor en una herramienta. Actualmente estoy desarrollando una aplicación diseñada para hacer ese trabajo pesado por ti: analizar tus reglas, validar si tienen ventaja estadística real y darte una dirección objetiva —o una reestructuración— cuando tu sistema no funciona.
No vengo a venderte humo ni fórmulas secretas. Sigo construyendo mi propia consistencia en el laboratorio real: los mercados, un algoritmo a la vez, paso a paso, demostrando que la matemática no miente. Si estás cansado de operar desde expectativas falsas que te han vendido de hacerte rico en pocos días y quieres empezar a validar tus reglas con rigor, y tener una dirección clara sobre cómo construir tus propias estrategias, acompáñame en este proceso.

Title: Just talked about tokenized assets the other day, and now Solana is stepping up its speed too

Solana has raised its speed to 200 milliseconds in October, putting $500 million in tokenized assets in the spotlight.

Just the other day, I posted about tokenized assets becoming increasingly concentrated in the hands of a few. Now the Solana Foundation has shared progress on its October upgrade. It mainly involved two things: first, cutting the target block time from 300 milliseconds to 200 milliseconds; and second, making it easier for tokenized assets to move around on-chain. What does 200 milliseconds mean? It’s roughly the time it takes to confirm a tip to a streamer—more than 100 times faster than Bitcoin. The $500 million in tokenized assets refers to things like NFTs that can be traded and borrowed against directly on the Solana chain, without having to move them to Ethereum as before. That’s like building a small ecosystem of its own for Solana, so it doesn’t always have to shop elsewhere. In a report published on November 6, the Foundation emphasized that these two upgrades will make the chain cheaper and faster.

Impact on the market
- Short term: SOL is sure to attract investors’ attention, since increased speed directly affects the experience of using Solana. That gives it a competitive edge over traditional heavyweights like Bitcoin. ETH is rising now, too, and if SOL can keep pace, it could be a bright spot among tech stocks.
- Medium term: If this speed boost can bring in more applications—such as games, social platforms, and DeFi—then SOL’s standing could rise even further. After all, speed is what the crypto market needs most right now. Bitcoin and Ethereum already dominate the fast-moving sectors, so Solana needs to offer something different.

My take
I see a short-term opportunity for Solana, mainly because its speed advantage is getting renewed attention. But as for whether it can outperform BTC and ETH, I think it’ll take at least another year. SOL is currently hovering around $90, right at the midpoint between this year’s resistance and support levels. If it breaks above $95 on strong volume, things could get interesting. That said, cryptocurrencies are highly unpredictable, and blockchain technology lacks the fundamentals of the real economy. Take this with a grain of salt—I’m only testing the waters with a small position myself.

Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly keep their money in this market are those who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day over 250 trading days in a year works out to 12x; steadily earning 10% a month,
works out to 30x over three years. It doesn’t sound thrilling, but it has one remarkable feature—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. Market opportunities are waited for; discipline is your own. Don’t set your goal
as “double your money this week”; set it as “make zero major mistakes this week.” The money from the former is given by the market,
while the ability behind the latter is yours. The market opens every day, but only those who preserve their principal are qualified to keep playing.

$HUMA: HUMA Hourly Move vs Peer Trends

The primary token $HUMA is showing an hourly direction down while its volume sits above baseline. This suggests that sellers are active, but the heightened volume may also provide a cushion against a rapid price drop. A simple way to test the strength of this move is to watch the average true range 9.10048e-05; if price stays within that band, the downtrend could be short‑lived.

Peer observations add context. Ethereum (ETH) is moving up on the hour and its volume remains near the normal level, indicating a smoother price rise without strong buying pressure. By contrast, MITO is also up and its volume exceeds baseline, a pattern that mirrors the current HUMA situation but with opposite price direction.

The key difference lies in how volume interacts with direction. When volume is high and price moves up, it often reflects conviction; when volume is high and price moves down, it may signal panic or defensive selling. The hourly window limits the view. price can reverse within the next few candles, so traders should reassess by comparing the next hourly direction against the current volume level.

💡 Consider checking the relative volume 2.01575 in the next hour to see if the pressure eases before making a decision.

Probabilistic market research, not a recommendation or guaranteed return.

The comparison to keep in mind: $ETH has hourly direction up and volume not above its baseline; $MITO has hourly direction up and volume above its baseline. This alone does not establish correlation.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A Stop-Loss Isn’t an Admission of Failure—It’s the Price of Admission to the Next Trade
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people struggle to pull the trigger on a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
gets in the way. Look at it another way: a stop-loss is insurance you bought in advance, and the premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn’t who’s more accurate, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The most disciplined traders I’ve ever seen are quicker than anyone to admit when they’re wrong. Because they know: whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn’t matter. What matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand trembles as you place a stop-loss, tell yourself
this is the price of admission, not a verdict.

EIP-1559 went live with the London upgrade on August 5, 2021, splitting Ethereum transaction fees into two parts: a base fee and a priority fee (tip).
The base fee is burned and does not go to the validator producing the block; the priority fee goes to the validator who includes the transaction.
You only realize after paying too much tuition: you should read the instructions first.

My understanding: TVL can rise because incentives attract short-term capital, which may quickly leave once the incentives end.
An asset may be double-counted: deposit it in Protocol A to receive a receipt token, then deposit that token in Protocol B, and both protocols count the asset in their TVL.
What I do: A higher TVL doesn't mean a protocol is safer. Protocols with more funds can also be more attractive targets for hackers.

我的做法：TVL 大不代表更安全，资金越多的协议同样容易被黑客盯上。

title: 十币24小时振幅都没过4%，量能只剩7日均量的一成
subTitle:
今天午间这个盘面，问题不在价格，在参与度。十个币的24小时振幅全部压在4%以内，成交量对7日均量的比值落在0.04到0.12之间，BTC 一整天的价格区间是 75571.08 到 76249.99，678 美元，只有它自己 ATR（2165.64）的三分之一。价格没往下走，不是有人在接，是压根没人推。

最低处

跌得最深的是 $ADA，24小时 -1.95%，十个币里排最后一位。它的24小时低点 0.1793 和30日低点 0.1777 只隔 0.9%，30日区间分位 3.5%，是十个里最低的那个；离30日高点 0.2595 已经退了 30.4%，回撤幅度也是十币里最深。

这些位置配上 0.08 的量能，读起来不像被卖下来，更像没人拦着让它自己滑。RSI 32.5，价格在 MA25 之下 11.35%，是十个币里离中期均线最远的一个，均线空头排列也排得最整齐。ATR 5.58%，日内本来有五个多点的波动空间，实际24小时只走了 3.29%。波动被压住，方向却没转，这是它现在最别扭的地方。

贴着轨

$XRP 的位置更极端。按布林带宽度算，它只站在 2.3% 的位置，价格 1.1624，下轨 1.1571，两者差 0.46%；24小时低点 1.15 正好压在30日低点 1.15 上。也就是说，过去一天它已经摸过这条底线，然后又收回来了。

但它的量能是 0.12，十个币里最高，是 AVAX（0.04）的三倍。低量环境里这点差别有意义：别的币是没人碰，XRP 是有人在 1.15 到 1.1821 这个不到 3% 的区间里真的换手。24小时它还是 +0.19%，涨得不多，但起码没跟着 ADA 往下挪。

三成不到

SOL 收在 89.34，24小时 -0.73%。RSI 29.9 是十个里最低的，比第二低的 XRP（31.5）还低 1.6 点。布林带位置 14.2%，30日区间分位 4.1%，只比 ADA 的 3.5% 高一点点；24小时低点 88.73 距30日低点 88.30 只有 0.5%，中间几乎没有缓冲。

它离 MA25 差 9.66%，在十个币里排第二远，仅次于 ADA。价格离得这么远，说明过去两周的下跌还没被任何一根均线接住，反弹连碰 MA7（91.29）都要费点力气。低量加上深贴均线，这种结构通常要等一根放量的 K 线才能改，横着磨是改不了的。

剩下七个

另外七个币挤在一段里说也够。BTC 75928.77，24小时 +0.08%，MA99 77503.78 还在头顶 2.03% 的位置没夺回来。ETH 2238.42，-0.23%，MACD 柱 0.94 还是正的，柱状线暂时没翻负。BNB 696.29，+0.36%。DOGE 0.07133，-0.89%，布林带位置 9.4%，也贴着下半区。AVAX 8.209，-1.20%，量能 0.04 是十个里最低的那个。LINK 10.786，-0.11%，12小时 -0.64% 是这一段里最弱的。TON 1.60，24小时 +0.95% 涨得最多，可4小时 -0.99% 也是吐得最多的。

十个币的 MA7 全部低于 MA25，价格全部在 MA99 下方，这个排列从上周末延续到现在，一次都没修过。30日区间分位则挤在 3.5% 到 19.8% 这段底部区域里，十币没有一个回到中位。

亚盘上午这一段，12小时维度上是五涨五跌，BTC +0.24%、ETH +0.21%、BNB +0.33%、AVAX +0.27%、XRP +0.20% 在上面，LINK -0.64%、ADA -0.61%、TON -0.56%、DOGE -0.45%、SOL -0.20% 在下面；到4小时维度变成四涨六跌，涨的那几个幅度全在 0.2% 以内。动能在衰减，但没有加速往下，属于横着磨的形态。

欧盘开盘前的区间其实好画。BTC 上方 76249.99，下方 75571.08，再往下是30日低点 74888.00；XRP 上方 1.1821，下方 1.15，中间夹着布林下轨 1.1571。这两个区间一根 K 线就能走完，所以欧盘真正的变量不是方向，是量能能不能从一成回到三成以上。量不回来，任何突破都容易是假的；量真回来了，往下击穿30日低点的概率反而更高，因为现在十个币没有一个站在 MA99 上方，上方没有现成的支撑结构可以借力。

一成量里做判断，误差本来就大。价格是实时的，上面这些只是这个时点的读法，真要动手还是看自己的仓位和止损，别把任何一句当成方向指令。

欧盘开盘之后，XRP 是先守住 1.1571 这条布林下轨，还是连 1.15 这个30日低点也一起交出去？

#BTC #ETH #ADA #XRP

ETHW quarterly report shows net holdings growth in Q3 | Daily flows still negative | Wait for confirmation on ETH and don’t chase highs

My stance is cautious to neutral. ETH is marked “Rapid Riser” among Binance Square’s six-hour trending searches, and attention is picking up. But search interest is not fund inflows, much less a guarantee that the price will break out. Today I’m looking at an original filing that could easily mislead readers who focus only on growth in assets: Bitwise Ethereum ETF (ETHW)’s 10-Q, filed with the U.S. SEC for the quarter ended September 30.

The filing says ETHW added approximately 22,524.76 ETH through share creations in Q3, reduced its holdings by approximately 17,948.12 ETH through share redemptions, and used approximately 51.95 ETH to pay management fees. Counting only creations minus redemptions, the net increase was approximately 4,576.64 ETH; fees must also be deducted to get closer to the actual change in the fund’s ETH holdings. During the same period, the fund’s net assets rose from approximately $168.47 million to $296.91 million. But the entire increase of approximately $128.44 million cannot be attributed to new money: the reference price of ETH used at quarter-end rose from approximately $1,576.51 to $2,673.48, making price appreciation a significant contributor. The fund held approximately 111,266.86 ETH at quarter-end. That is the balance as of September 30, not its real-time position today. The 10-Q also shows 3.15 million shares created and 2.51 million redeemed in Q3, for a net increase of 640,000 shares. This is consistent with the change in ETH holdings and provides a second point of verification.

The market mechanism here is that net creations of a fund typically require corresponding underlying assets. However, cash or in-kind creations and redemptions, execution timing, and hedging methods can all affect when spot buying takes place. So the quarterly figures cannot be mechanically converted into buying pressure today. Short-term data should be considered separately: according to Farside, U.S. ETH funds saw combined net outflows of approximately $93.3 million on November 6, while ETHW alone saw an outflow of approximately $1.7 million. The quarterly net increase and the single-day net outflow occurred over different time windows, so these two facts do not conflict. ETH/USDT on Binance is around $2,238, down approximately 0.12% over the rolling 24 hours, with a high of $2,251.54 and a low of $2,223.15. The news has not produced a confirmed one-way breakout. The Federal Reserve held its target interest rate range at 3.75% to 4% on October 28, and the next inflation data release will still affect risk-asset valuations.

If I were trading this myself, I would not enter at this point. My planned position is currently 0%, and I would only consider going long unleveraged spot. For an entry, I’d need to see ETH reclaim $2,252 and hold above $2,240 on a retest, while the next available daily fund-flow data shows no more large net outflows. If both conditions are met, I’d use no more than 0.35% of total capital to test the position. The first target is $2,280, where I’d take half off; the next is $2,320, where I’d raise the protective stop on the remaining position. After entry, I’d stop out immediately if the price falls below $2,222. If the price closes back below the bottom of the range or fund flows continue to weaken, I’d close the entire position. If subsequent disclosures show that net share creations have reversed, or ETH repeatedly fails to break above $2,252, my view that institutional demand is improving would be invalidated, and I’d stay out of the market and wait.

ETHW季报显示三季度净增仓｜单日资金仍流出｜ETH等确认不追高

我的态度是谨慎偏中性。币安广场六小时热搜里ETH标着Rapid Riser，关注度上来了，但搜索热度不是基金申购，更不是价格一定突破。今天看一份容易被资产规模增长误导的原始文件：Bitwise Ethereum ETF（ETHW）向美国SEC提交的截至9月30日季度10-Q。

文件写明，三季度ETHW因份额创建增加约22524.76枚ETH，又因份额赎回减少约17948.12枚，另有约51.95枚用于支付管理费。只算创建减赎回，净额约4576.64枚；扣除费用后才接近基金持币的真实变动。同期基金净资产从约1.6847亿美元增至2.9691亿美元，但不能把约1.2844亿美元的增幅都说成新钱：季末所用ETH参考价从约1576.51美元升至2673.48美元，价格上涨是重要贡献。季度末持有约111266.86枚ETH，这也是9月30日的存量，不是今天的实时仓位。10-Q还显示三季度份额创建315万份、赎回251万份，净增加64万份，与持币变化方向一致，构成第二层核对。

这件事对市场的机制是，基金净创建通常需要对应底层资产，但现金申赎、实物申赎、执行时间和对冲方式会改变现货买入的时点，不能机械地把季报数字换算成今天的买盘。眼下短期数据反而要单列：Farside的11月6日美国ETH基金合计净流出约9330万美元，ETHW单只约流出170万美元；季度净增与单日净流出发生在不同时间窗，两个事实并不冲突。币安ETH/USDT约2238美元，滚动24小时约跌0.12%，高点2251.54、低点2223.15，消息没有带来可确认的单边上破。美联储10月28日维持目标利率区间3.75%至4%，下次通胀数据仍会影响风险资产估值。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与，现有计划仓位0%，只考虑无杠杆现货做多。入场要同时看到ETH重新站上2252美元并回踩守住2240，以及下一次可得的基金日度数据不再大额净流出，届时最多动用总资金0.35%试仓。目标先看2280，到位减半；再看2320，剩余仓位抬高保护止损。入场后跌破2222立即止损；若价格收回区间下沿之下或资金持续走弱，全部平仓。若后续披露显示基金份额净增逆转、ETH多次冲不过2252，我对机构需求改善的判断就失效，继续空仓等待。

#ETH

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间二零二六年十一月八日上午，以太坊现货价格报二千二百三十三美元，过去二十四小时下跌百分之零点三九。价格主要在二千二百三十至二千二百四十美元区间内窄幅震荡，最近五根小时K线显示市场在低位反复试探支撑后小幅回升，最高触及二千二百四十一点三七美元，最低下探二千二百二十九点五六美元。

以太坊近期走势与比特币高度相关，同样受到美国中期选举结果和宏观数据超预期的双重打压。但值得注意的是，以太坊在二千二百二十九美元附近获得了较为有效的买盘支撑，小时级别RSI曾短暂跌入三十以下的超卖区域后迅速反弹，显示该位置存在较强的抄底意愿。

从波动率角度来看，以太坊的ATR指标从八点六逐步下降至七点六五，标准差也从三点六五降至一点九二，表明市场波动正在显著收窄。这种低波动状态通常预示着即将出现较大幅度的方向性运动，投资者需要密切关注突破方向的信号。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七周期MA报二千二百三十六美元，二十五周期MA报二千二百四十一点六美元，九十九周期MA高达二千二百九十一美元。价格运行在所有主要均线下方，短中长期均线呈空头排列。指数移动均线同样显示压制格局，七周期EMA为二千二百三十六点四美元，二十五周期EMA为二千二百三十九点四美元，九十九周期EMA为二千二百六十七美元，长期均线对价格形成明显阻力。

MACD指标显示，快线报负二点八零，慢线报负三点二三，柱状图回升至正零点四四。与比特币类似，以太坊的MACD柱状图也在持续改善，空头动能逐步衰减，但快慢线仍深处于零轴下方，短期内形成有效金叉的难度较大。

RSI指标方面，六周期RSI回升至五十一二点二，重新站上五十中轴，十二周期RSI为四十七点五五，二十四周期RSI为四十四点四三。短期RSI的反弹力度略强于比特币，暗示以太坊的短期买盘相对更为积极。

布林带上轨二千二百五十点五美元，中轨二千二百三十九点二美元，下轨二千二百二十七点九美元。价格在布林带中轨附近运行，带宽收窄趋势明显。抛物线SAR报二千二百四十七美元，超级趋势线固定在二千二百五十一美元，两者均位于价格上方，维持看空信号。

技术面综合指标给出做多信号，十五个因子中八个指向做多，六个指向做空，做多比例达到百分之五十三点三，这与比特币的空头占优形成鲜明对比。综合指标的胜率高达百分之八十二点九八，其中做多胜率为百分之七十八点五七，做空胜率为百分之八十九点四七，显示当前做多信号具有较高的可信度。

三、市场情绪分析

尽管以太坊价格持续承压，但链上数据和市场结构出现了多个积极信号。首先，智能钱地址近期部署了约两千万美元买入以太坊，同时某鲸鱼地址在六天内从交易所提走超过一万三千枚ETH，显示大户正在逆势吸筹。其次，知名资产管理公司在以太坊上推出了追踪STOXX Europe 600指数的代币化股票产品，进一步巩固了以太坊在现实世界资产代币化领域的主导地位。

然而，风险因素同样不容忽视。现货以太坊ETF已连续六周录得净流出，累计流出规模约二十亿美元，近期单周流出九千三百三十万美元。机构资金的持续撤离对短期价格形成压制。此外，Glamsterdam升级因费用计算问题被暂停，MetaMask质押奖励也出现安全漏洞，协议层面的不确定性增加了持有风险。

宏观面上，美国强劲的就业数据强化了美联储加息预期，对包括以太坊在内的所有加密资产构成流动性收紧压力。但以太坊相对比特币展现出更强的技术面做多信号和链上买盘支撑，若宏观环境出现缓和迹象，ETH可能率先迎来反弹行情。短期关注二千二百二十七美元布林带下轨支撑，上方阻力位在二千二百五十美元布林带上轨。

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

go from a few dozen points to zero in just one or two big bearish candles.

【The mathematical truth】The essence of rolling positions is “being right repeatedly.” If your win rate is 60% each time, the chance of being right four times in a row
is only 13%. Behind every post about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.

看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Scaling: How to Add to a Trend Trade as It Rises Without Wiping Out
translatedData.subTitle:
If you’ve read the trend correctly and want to add to your position, how should you do it? Going all-in from the start and adding on all your unrealized gains is a surefire way to end up on the liquidation list.
A common one. The right approach is called pyramid scaling.

【Principle】Each time you add to your position, add less than the time before. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first confirmed pullback,
After confirmation, add another 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position becomes, keeping your average cost low so you can withstand a pullback.

【Why the reverse is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more at the top) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn your gains into losses; once you lose your nerve, every trade goes wrong.

The EVM charges Gas for each instruction. Once a transaction runs out of Gas, it stops and rolls back any state changes, so infinite loops can’t hold up the entire network.
When using different EVM-compatible chains, addresses may look the same, but you need to make sure you know which chain your assets are on.
When calling a contract on Ethereum, the EVM charges Gas for every instruction it executes. Pay with $ETH .

Why can you get hacked just by signing something, even though it doesn't cost any Gas?
A permit signature contains fields such as the owner, the authorized party, the allowance amount, the nonce, and the expiration time.
This type of signature is not an on-chain transaction, so signing it doesn't require Gas. But whoever gets the signature can submit it on-chain to make the authorization take effect.

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Rule: Why You Need to Be Able to Afford Losses to Last
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule everyone’s heard to death but 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on a single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 USDT in capital, 2% means a maximum loss of 200 USDT per trade. After 10 consecutive losses, you’d still have 8,000,
If your account is down just 20%, a few winning trades can bring it back. On the other hand, if you go all-in and lose 30% each time,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34%. You’d need to almost triple what’s left to break even—mathematically, you’re pretty much out of the game.

【How to apply it】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%.” It’s “when this trade hits its stop-loss, the amount you lose
must not exceed 2%.” So the right order is: find your stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work backward to determine your position size.

title: 2026年11月8日｜币圈分析：当下不是熊市尾声，是牛市中继挖坑
subTitle:
2026年11月8日｜币圈随笔：当下不是熊市尾声，是牛市中继挖坑
 
最近整个币圈的情绪，基本只剩两种状态：恐慌、麻木。
 
打开任意财经资讯、行情社区，铺天盖地全是利空消息。久而久之，多数人已经形成固化认知：BTC还会继续深跌、现在依旧是熊市行情、本轮牛市根本没有真正启动。甚至不少技术派开始预判，BTC会走周线级别头肩底结构，右肩底部要回踩 67000–68000 区间。
 
但我的观点和市场主流悲观情绪完全相反：当前区域就是本轮调整的底部区间。即便周线连续收阴、盘面弱势尽显，我依旧坚定看好多头行情，看好在圣诞行情窗口来临前，BTC重回 93000 高位。
 
其实在BTC高点87000一带时，我就给出过年底93000的目标，当时市场情绪亢奋，几乎所有人都愿意相信。但经过这轮深度回调，币价回落至75000附近，全网质疑声四起。
 
但真正有价值的判断，从来不是顺势跟风，而是利空扎堆、人心涣散时依旧坚持逻辑。不做马后炮，底部的看多预判，才具备真正的参考意义。下面完整拆解我的看涨核心逻辑。
 
一、周线MA50牛熊铁律，本轮牛市结构从未破坏
 
复盘BTC近数年的周期规律，有一条极其稳定的核心定律：
 
自2018年熊市结束、BTC首次站稳周线MA50之后，每一轮牛市周期内，周线MA50只会出现假跌破、快速收回，不会出现有效真破位。
 
一旦周线MA50有效跌破，就意味着本轮牛市彻底终结，进入新一轮长周期熊市，而这种级别的切换，三年之内只会出现一次。
 
近数年唯一的例外，是2020年3月的全球疫情黑天鹅。那是百年难遇的系统性风险，全球供应链全面停摆，资本市场集体崩盘。当时大宗商品极端走弱，原油期货甚至跌至负值，属于极端历史级行情，无法用常规技术周期、市场逻辑衡量。
 
抛开这种级别的不可抗力黑天鹅，本轮牛市的周线结构、中期趋势，至今完好无损，所谓熊市重来，根本不成立。
 
二、矿工成本托底，上市矿企形成隐形护盘底线
 
很多散户对BTC最大的误区：认为虚拟币没有实际成本，涨跌全凭情绪和资金。
 
实际上BTC拥有清晰、刚性的生产成本底线，也就是全网矿工的综合电费成本。目前全网挖矿的综合成本，稳定落在 72000美元 一线。
 
简单直白讲：币价低于72000，全网矿工挖矿即亏损，挖一枚亏一枚。
 
从市场逻辑来说，无利可图的产能一定会出清：矿机关机、算力回落、抛压衰减，资金反而会在成本线附近博弈底部支撑。
 
这里分享一个极少有人注意、我复盘总结的全新周期规律：
 
在比特大陆、比特小鹿等头部矿企陆续上市之后，BTC的熊市生态已经彻底改写。
 
2022年熊市，BTC曾长期跌破挖矿成本线，在关机价下方震荡近两个月。但现阶段的市场环境，已经不可能复刻当年的走势。
 
上市矿企的核心营收、主营业务就是挖矿，如果币价长期低于成本线，持续亏损运营，会直接影响企业财报、估值和二级市场股价，引发机构投资人恐慌，形成连锁负面反馈。
 
因此，上市头部矿企有极强的护盘动力：在币价逼近72000成本线时，主动维稳市场、减少砸盘、锁住筹码，守住成本底线，保障企业正常经营与资本市场信心。
 
最直观的佐证：即便周五BTC现货ETF出现大额净流出、利空情绪发酵，币价依旧稳稳守住75000上方，充分体现了成本线与产业资金的强力托底。
 
三、市场情绪极致恐慌，是经典的底部反转信号
 
当下BTC恐慌贪婪指数仅 24，处于极度恐慌区间。
 
资本市场永远遵循反人性定律：狂热顶、恐慌底。
 
所有大级别底部，无一例外都是在利空集中爆发、散户集体恐慌割肉、全网看空的情绪中诞生；而所有历史大顶，都是在全民狂热、一致看多中悄然形成。
 
现在市场麻木、绝望、不敢看多的情绪，恰恰是底部最典型的特征。不需要极致贪婪，只要市场情绪不再单边恐慌，行情就会迎来修复反弹。
 
四、牛市节奏从未改变：进三步、退两步
 
纵观BTC每一轮完整牛市，核心节奏从未变过：趋势上涨、中继深调、蓄力新高。
 
行情顺势拉升时，全网一片看涨，人人笃定牛市破新高；但每一次深度回调，市场都会立刻忘记牛市逻辑，一致高喊熊市归来、币价归零。
 
这就是牛市最难赚钱的地方：拿得住趋势，扛不住回调。
 
真正的长线布局，从来不是在行情火爆时跟风，而是在所有人放弃的时候，坚守周期逻辑、握住低位筹码。
 
结尾预判
 
综合技术周期、产业成本、市场情绪三大核心维度，当前所有信号都指向底部筑底、即将变盘。
 
我预判：下周大概率迎来周线级别触底反转窗口。
 
不必被短期阴跌和利空左右心态，本轮只是牛市正常的中继洗盘，并非熊市开启。坐稳筹码，耐心等待年底行情修复，93000的目标依旧有效。

ETHB Q3 report: staking amount rises｜staking ratio falls｜ETH still near 2233, awaiting confirmation

My stance is to wait and see. For now, I would not treat the increase in institutional staking holdings as a signal that ETH will rebound today. BlackRock’s iShares Staked Ethereum Trust ETF (ETHB) Q3 10-Q, disclosed by the U.S. SEC, shows that as of September 30, 337,045 ETH had been delegated to third-party staking, representing 76.4% of the fund’s ETH holdings. Compared with 250,585 ETH, or 86.9%, on June 30, the amount staked increased by 86,460 ETH, while its share fell by 10.5 percentage points. Both figures can be true at once: the fund’s total ETH holdings grew faster than its staking allocation. You can’t just pick out the words “staking amount increased” and infer that there is buying pressure right now.

This quarterly report explains the holdings structure at the end of September; it does not show real-time fund flows on November 8. Staking rewards are not fixed interest, either: the fund remains exposed to ETH price, validator services, unstaking, and redemption liquidity risks. Rewards, after staking fees, are intended to be distributed in U.S. dollars monthly, at least quarterly, and the actual amount may vary. What can truly affect short-term trading is whether new creations and redemptions, and spot demand, improve consistently. Farside recorded combined net outflows of $93.3 million from U.S. ETH funds on November 6, while ETHB saw a modest net inflow of $1.1 million. A small one-day inflow into one product does not outweigh the fact that market-wide flows remain cautious, nor does it mean that an equivalent amount of ETH was directly locked up that day.

The market reaction should also be considered separately. Early this morning, ETH/USDT on Binance was around $2,233, down about 0.75% over the rolling 24 hours from around $2,250, with a high of 2,251.54 and a low of 2,223.15. The decline came after the quarterly report was disclosed, but I can’t attribute it to the report; expectations for macro interest rates, sentiment toward risk assets, and fund flows may all have played a role at the same time. I’m watching support at 2,223 and resistance at 2,252. Holding above 2,252 and then retesting it without breaking below would indicate that selling pressure may be easing. If ETH breaks below 2,223 and stays there, my short-term stabilization view is invalidated. If fund data continues to show outflows afterward, I’ll be less confident even if the price briefly spikes.

If I were trading myself, I would stay out for now, keep a neutral directional bias, and hold a 0% position. I would only consider a no-leverage spot long using at most 0.4% of my total capital if ETH closes above 2,252 on the one-hour chart, then retests and holds 2,245, and there are no new major negative announcements. I’d take half off at the first target of 2,275 and close the rest at the second target of 2,295. After entering, I’d stop out of the entire position if the one-hour candle closes below 2,238. If price breaks below 2,223 first, I’d cancel the entry plan. If the price doesn’t meet the trigger conditions, I’d rather stay out than describe waiting as if it were already profitable.

我的态度是观望，暂不把机构质押持仓增长当作ETH今天会反弹的信号。美国SEC披露的贝莱德iShares Staked Ethereum Trust ETF（ETHB）三季度10-Q显示，截至9月30日有337045枚ETH委托第三方质押，占基金ETH持仓的76.4%。对比6月30日的250585枚、86.9%，质押数量增加86460枚，占比却下降10.5个百分点。两项同时成立，说明基金持有的ETH总量扩张速度快于质押配置速度；不能只截取“质押量增加”四个字来推断现时买盘。

这份季报解释的是9月底的存量结构，不是11月8日的实时资金流。质押奖励也不是固定利息：基金仍承担ETH价格、验证服务、解押及赎回流动性风险，扣除质押费后的奖励拟按月、至少按季以美元分配，实际金额会变。真正能影响短线交易的是新增申赎和现货承接能否连续改善。Farside记录11月6日美国ETH基金合计净流出9330万美元，其中ETHB小幅净流入110万美元。一个产品的单日小额流入，抵不过全市场资金仍偏谨慎的事实，也不代表该日直接锁仓了等额ETH。

市场反应也要分开看。今早币安ETH/USDT约2233美元，滚动24小时从2250附近回落约0.75%，高点2251.54、低点2223.15。下跌发生在季报披露之后，但我不能把它归因于季报；宏观利率预期、风险资产情绪和资金流都可能同时作用。我的观察位是2223支撑和2252压力。站稳2252且回踩不破，才说明卖压有机会减轻；若跌破2223并持续停留其下，短线企稳判断作废。若随后基金数据继续流出，即使价格短暂冲高，我也会降低信心。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向维持中性，现仓位0%。只在ETH一小时收盘高于2252、随后回踩守住2245，且没有新的重大负面公告时，才考虑用总资金最多0.4%做无杠杆现货试多。第一目标2275减一半，第二目标2295平掉余仓；买入后若一小时收盘低于2238就止损全平，若先破2223则取消入场计划。若价格没给触发条件，宁可空仓，也不把等待写成已经盈利。

Two on-chain moves point to the same conclusion: some large holders are using ETH as a source of financing and funds for portfolio rotation, rather than simply betting against it. This conclusion depends on one caveat: redemptions and exchange deposits are only the first steps in the flow of funds; the source material does not yet show whether the ETH was ultimately sold, or how much.

First, the facts. According to PANews on November 8, citing monitoring by Ai Yi, a large restaking holder redeemed 7,500 ETH from Etherfi over the past three days, worth more than $17.11 million, and then deposited it to Binance. The address still has 1,483.94 ETH staked with Kelp DAO. On the same day, PANews cited monitoring by Onchain Lens showing that another whale converted 493.15 ETH into approximately 14.5 BTC via THORChain. The two records have one thing in common: ETH left its previous position. The difference is that one flow went to a centralized exchange, while the other was directly converted into BTC.

My read is that this looks more like an adjustment to restaking exposure than a one-way retreat. Redeeming restaking positions and depositing ETH to an exchange could indicate a sale, but could also be for collateral or liquidity purposes; converting ETH to BTC, on the other hand, is an explicit asset swap. This suggests that when ETH is not attractive relative to BTC, some capital may choose to reduce its ETH exposure while remaining in the crypto market, rather than exit altogether. But a deposit does not mean a sale, and rotating into another asset does not necessarily mean a bearish view on ETH. Both steps require follow-up data to confirm.

To assess whether this interpretation holds, watch for three conditions: whether net ETH inflows to exchanges continue to grow alongside price weakness; whether TVL in restaking protocols such as Etherfi continues to decline; and whether the ETH/BTC ratio falls further. If deposits are not followed by significant selling pressure, or restaking levels rebound quickly, the above “rotation” interpretation will need to be revised.

The key indicators to track are subsequent net exchange inflows, restaking TVL, and the ETH/BTC ratio, with a monitoring window of the next several weeks. This article is for analysis of market mechanisms only and does not constitute investment advice.

两笔链上动作指向同一个判断：ETH正被部分大户当作融资与换仓来源，而不是被单纯看空。这个判断成立的前提是，赎回和充值只是资金链条的前半段，最终是否卖出、卖了多少，本次素材尚未给出。

先看事实。据PANews 11月8日援引Ai姨监测，一个再质押大户近三天从Etherfi赎回7500枚ETH，价值超1711万美元，随后充值至币安，该地址仍在Kelp DAO质押1483.94枚ETH。同一日，PANews援引Onchain Lens监测，另一巨鲸通过THORChain将493.15枚ETH兑换为约14.5枚BTC。两条记录的共同点是ETH离开原有位置，区别在于一条流向中心化交易所，一条直接换成BTC。

我的观察是，这更像再质押资金的敞口调整，而非单向撤退。赎回再质押凭证、把ETH充值进交易所，可能对应卖出，也可能只是抵押或流动性安排；换成BTC则是明确的资产替换。据此推断，当ETH相对BTC的比价缺乏吸引力时，部分资金会选择降低ETH敞口、保留加密市场仓位，而不是离场。但充值不等于卖出，换仓也不等于看空ETH，这两步都需要后续数据补全。

判断是否成立，要看三个条件：交易所ETH净流入是否持续放大并伴随价格走弱；Etherfi等再质押协议的TVL是否继续下降；ETH/BTC比价是否进一步走低。如果充值后没有明显卖压，或再质押规模很快回升，上述“换仓迁移”的判断就需要修正。

值得跟踪的是后续交易所净流入、再质押TVL和ETH/BTC比价，观察窗口放在未来数周。本文仅为机制分析，不构成投资建议。

以太坊市场深度分析：弱势整理中孕育反弹机会

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间二零二六年十一月八日上午九时，以太坊对美元报价为二千二百三十五点六九美元，过去二十四小时内下跌约百分之零点四四。从小时K线来看，价格在二千二百三十二美元至二千二百四十一美元之间窄幅震荡，整体呈现缩量整理格局。

均线系统方面，七周期均线报二千二百三十四点六六美元，二十五周期均线报二千二百四十点九三美元，九十九周期均线高居二千二百九十二点一八美元。当前价格运行在所有主要均线下方，短期均线呈空头排列。价格距离九十九周期均线存在约五十六美元的差距，短期内突破难度较大。

指数移动平均线同样显示空头格局，七周期EMA报二千二百三十五点五三美元，二十五周期EMA报二千二百三十九点四四美元，九十九周期EMA报二千二百六十七点五二美元。价格被压制在所有EMA下方，反弹空间受到明显限制。

布林带上轨位于二千二百五十一美元附近，中轨约二千二百三十九点五五美元，下轨约二千二百二十七点七七美元。价格在中轨下方运行，接近布林带中部偏下区域。布林带持续收窄，波动率降低，暗示市场正在积蓄能量等待方向选择。

二、技术指标解读

相对强弱指标六周期数值为四十二点四八，十二周期为四十三点六零，二十四周期为四十二点九三，均处于五十下方，显示短期动量偏弱，但距离超卖区域仍有一定距离。KDJ指标中K值为五十九点三四，D值为五十三点零三，J值为七十一一点九七，三线在中性偏上区域运行，K线在D线上方，短期存在一定支撑。

MACD指标方面，快线报负三点二二，慢线报负三点三八，柱状图为正零点一五五。MACD虽然仍在零轴下方，但柱状图已经转正，快线正在向慢线靠拢，有形成金叉的迹象。如果金叉确认，可能为短期反弹提供动能。

抛物线指标报二千二百四十八美元，位于当前价格上方，构成短期阻力。超级趋势指标在二千二百五十一美元上方发出看空信号。平均真实波幅为七点六美元，波动率处于较低水平。

从量化因子来看，十五个因子中十个发出做多信号，四个做空，一个中性，做多比例高达百分之六十六点六七。综合指标给出做多信号，胜率百分之七十八点五七，表明在当前位置多方力量相对占优。这与比特币的空头综合信号形成对比，显示以太坊的相对强度可能优于比特币。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场同样受到宏观紧缩环境的压制。现货以太坊ETF近期持续录得净流出，最近单日流出约九千三百一十九万美元，机构资金的撤离对价格形成持续压力。美国十月非农数据大超预期，美联储加息预期升温，风险资产普遍承压。

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Staged profit-taking: How to lock in gains while letting profits run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because a stop-loss means overcoming fear, while taking profits means resisting greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and then you regret not getting out when it pulls back. Here's the staged profit-taking approach I've been using.

【Three stages】Stage 1: When price reaches the first target (for example, a 1:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell a third to lock in some profit,
At this point, the trade can no longer end in a loss, and your mindset immediately changes. Stage 2: When price reaches the second target
(for example, a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell another third. Stage 3: Let the rest ride with a trailing stop; exit if price falls below the moving average
or the previous low, and let your profits run.

【Why this works】If you sell everything too early, you'll kick yourself. If you hold everything, you often ride the elevator all the way back down.

夜市摊主收摊前跟我说，抄底这事跟抢最后一串烤鱿鱼一个道理：看着便宜，手一抖，整串掉地上。

被强平之后才懂，问题不在那一单，是之前的 portfolio（投资组合）早就满到没留 cash（现金）兜底。

$ETH 现在 2245.65 美元，涨了 0.45%——数字看着稳住了，可 24 小时里多单还是被强平了 647.9 万美元。

摊主说他现在学精了：留一半 cash 在手里，剩下的才敢慢慢 upgrade（升级）摊位，先活下来，再谈翻身。

结果他今晚收摊最早，钱包却最鼓。

你被强平之后，第一件事是先复盘，还是先给自己放一天假？

TRX is currently showing an hourly direction up while volume sits above baseline. The move sits above resistance, suggesting momentum but the sustainability of the rise remains uncertain.

### What the peer observations add
Both ETH and ACT display hourly direction down and volume not above baseline on the same exchange. Their lack of volume support contrasts with TRX's stronger trading activity. This difference shows that a shared direction does not automatically imply a common driver. The peers’ down moves are occurring without the volume lift that typically validates a strong trend, so their price pressure may be weaker.

### What this comparison cannot establish
The observation that TRX moves up while peers move down does not prove any causal link. It simply highlights that direction and volume can diverge across assets. The comparison cannot determine whether the direction or the way the move holds is more important; that judgment depends on how long the volume advantage persists.

### Reassessing the interpretation
Monitor whether TRX can maintain its upward bias as volume returns to baseline levels. A retreat in volume while price stays high would suggest a fragile move, whereas continued volume strength would reinforce the upside.

What exactly is a smart contract?
Most contracts on Ethereum are written in Solidity. After being compiled into bytecode, they are deployed on-chain and executed in the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM).
Smart contracts can't access off-chain data on their own, so when they need external information such as prices, they rely on oracles to bring it on-chain.
Deploying a smart contract on Ethereum requires paying $ETH  in Gas.

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where exactly should you place a stop-loss? How I choose between technical levels and percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop matters more than whether you set one. Too close, and it gets hit every day; too far, and one loss can hurt badly.

【Fixed-percentage method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. Simple and straightforward, suitable for beginners
It helps build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop might land right where other traders’ stops are clustered.

【Technical-level stop-loss method】Place it where the setup is invalidated: for a long position, below key support; for a short position, place it
above resistance. The logic is: if this level breaks, it’s evidence that I was wrong.

title: 周日早盘：周六约 7.63 没守住，夜里吐了约 680——周五约 7.49 的坑，整个周末都没人再踩
subTitle:
公开行情里 BTC 这会儿约 7.58 万（近 24 小时约 -0.2%），高点约 7.63、低点约 7.56。周六傍晚还在约 7.62，白天高点摸到约 7.63，等于把周五夜里约 7.49 的坑抬了约 1300；过了一夜，这截修复先吐了约 680，清晨探到约 7.56，随后又磨回约 7.58。ETH 约 2238（约 -0.2%），周六傍晚那截约 +1% 的相对优势基本没了；BNB 约 696（约 +0.2%）仍是主流里略扛住的；SOL 约 89.5（约 -1.0%），XRP 约 1.16（约 -1.6%）还在掉——周末弱的还是它。

周日早盘这个位置，我不把「没再踩约 7.49」直接读成磨底成功：更刺眼的是，波动被关进了一个很窄的盒子。从约 8.05 万甩到约 7.49 那一脚，两天里甩出五千多刀；进入周末之后，高点约 7.63、低点约 7.54，高低只剩约 840，而这会儿的约 7.58 几乎卡在这个窄区间正中间。外盘现金盘休息，币圈更像在自己的周末盒子里耗着。

结构上我更盯三件事：一是约 7.54～7.63 这个周末盒子，周一外盘前会不会先砸向约 7.49，还是继续缩着等验真；二是 ETH 相对优势回吐之后，SOL/XRP 会不会继续拖 beta——若大饼横着、山寨还在掉，说明周末资金仍在降风险；三是 BNB 相对抗跌能不能维持，还是开始补跌。

我个人怎么读这个周日早盘（仅观察，非投资建议）：

1. 把「约 7.63→约 7.56 再磨回约 7.58」当成周末薄流动性下的修复回吐，比当成新一轮下跌启动便宜——约 7.49 的坑还在视野里，但整整一个周末没人去碰，本身也是一种态度。
2. 波幅从五千多刀切到约 840，并不等于伤好了：只是周末没人定价。纳指期货大约周一早上 7 点（上海时间）重新开，才是验周五科技股那脚有没有消化完的时刻。
3. 今天到明天的顺序：7.54～7.63 盒子守不守得住 → ETH/SOL/XRP 相对弱势会不会收窄 → 周一开盘前约 7.58 这个中枢还在不在。

你怎么看：这算「周末把波动关进盒子、等周一验真」，还是「约 7.49 只是被推迟的下一脚」？评论区聊聊。

Grayscale ETH staking fund discloses yield | Q3 net staking income: $9.809 million | ETH spot still awaiting confirmation above $2,251

My stance is cautious observation: institutional staking income should not be treated as immediate buying pressure for ETH. The Q3 10-Q for the Grayscale Ethereum Staking Mini ETF, recently disclosed by the U.S. SEC, shows that the fair value of the ETH staked by the fund at the end of September was about $1.992 billion, and its Q3 Staking Reward Income was about $9.809 million. The financial statements are in thousands of dollars, so this should not be misread as $98.09 million. The fund had net assets of about $2.481 billion at period-end, with staked assets accounting for roughly 80%; Grayscale's official product page also notes that returns vary and are not fixed interest.

Staking generates protocol rewards denominated in ETH, which, after fees, may increase the ETH value represented by each fund share. The quarterly report says related fees totaled 6% of gross staking rewards, and reported income is stated net, so $9.809 million should not be treated as gross income. Staking also increases exit risk: unstaking and withdrawals may take time and depend on third-party service providers. When short-term redemption pressure rises, yields and liquidity need to be assessed together. It broadens institutional sources of returns, but does not guarantee a rise in the token price.

The fund created 14.2 million shares and redeemed 6.6 million shares in Q3, a net increase of 7.6 million shares, bringing the period-end total to about 97.3908 million shares; the rise in net assets was also affected by the increase in ETH's price, so it cannot all be attributed to new money. The September-end quarterly report and the November 6 fund flows are also from different points in time. Farside data show total net outflows of about $93.3 million from U.S. ETH funds on November 6; Grayscale's ETH ticker was listed at zero that day. The market-wide outflow should not be attributed to Grayscale Mini. Square's Most Searched lists ETH as a Rapid Riser, which only indicates rising attention.

以太坊市场深度分析：鲸鱼护盘与ETF流出的拉锯战

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十一月八日凌晨，以太坊现货报价二千二百三十六美元，过去二十四小时内微跌约百分之零点一六。价格在二千二百二十五至二千二百四十一美元的极窄区间内波动，整体呈现弱势盘整格局。从小时K线来看，最近五根蜡烛线实体极小，成交量逐步萎缩，最新一根K线成交额仅约二百四十六万美元，显示市场观望情绪浓厚。

均线系统方面，七日均线二千二百三十五美元已下穿二十五日均线二千二百四十二美元，形成短期空头排列。九十九周期指数移动平均线位于二千二百九十三美元上方，距离当前价格有约百分之二点五的差距，反映出中期趋势仍然偏弱。布林带上轨二千二百五十三美元、中轨二千二百四十一美元、下轨二千二百二十九美元，价格在中轨附近徘徊，方向选择迫在眉睫。

二、技术指标解读

综合指标方面，十五个因子中七个做多、七个做空、一个中性，综合指标值为正零点四九二，整体发出做多信号，历史胜率为百分之七十六点九。这与比特币的偏空信号形成对比，说明以太坊在技术面上存在一定的独立走强潜力。

MACD指标显示DIF线负三点三五、DEA线负三点四九，柱状图已连续两个周期转正且达到零点一三，空头动能明显衰减。虽然MACD仍在零轴下方运行，但柱状图的持续改善暗示短期存在反弹动能。

RSI指标方面，六周期RSI从低位回升至四十五点八，十二周期RSI为四十五点零，均回到中性区域附近，短期超卖状态已得到修复。KDJ指标表现较为积极，K线五十四点八、D线四十四点四、J线七十五点六，J线快速上冲显示短期买盘力量在增强。

威廉指标从负三十四回落至负五十三，超买压力已释放。ATR波动率降至八点三三，为近期低位，与比特币类似，波动率收窄预示着方向性突破即将到来。随机RSI指标从低位快速回升至六十九点二，已接近超买区域，短期需警惕回调风险。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临的市场环境与比特币有相似之处但也有自身特点。从资金面看，现货以太坊ETF在十一月六日录得九千三百三十万美元净流出，延续了数周以来的机构减持趋势，这对价格反弹形成了明显压制。

然而与比特币不同的是，链上数据显示鲸鱼地址和新建地址正在通过大额提币积极吸收现货供应量，这在一定程度上为二千二百三十美元关键支撑位提供了防守力量。交易所以太坊存量持续下降，供需格局正在悄然改善。

从基本面来看，以太坊格拉姆斯特德升级因合约执行漏洞而推迟，这在短期内打击了开发者社区的信心和市场对技术迭代的期待。不过从长期来看，升级推迟也意味着团队选择了更审慎的态度，避免了潜在的安全风险。

宏观层面，美国就业数据超预期带来的加息预期同样对以太坊构成压力，风险资产整体承压。但三星钱包集成USDC为八千两千万用户打开加密入口，以及稳定币赛道的持续扩展，为以太坊生态的长期发展提供了基础设施支撑。

综合判断，以太坊短期在二千二百三十至二千二百五十美元区间内震荡的概率较大。若能有效突破二千二百五十美元阻力，有望向二千三百美元发起挑战。反之，若跌破二千二百三十美元支撑，则可能下探二千二百美元整数关口。建议投资者密切关注ETF资金流向变化以及链上鲸鱼动向。

Hong Kong recently granted HK$23 billion in subsidies to blockchain projects, specifically targeting major initiatives such as tokenizing assets and stablecoins. The government says the funding supported nine projects in areas including real estate, payments, and identity verification. And that’s not all: Hong Kong’s Securities and Futures Commission is also set to approve 13 tokenization projects. Taken together, this suggests Hong Kong wants to make asset tokenization a key development priority—after all, it’s more practical than simply speculating on crypto.

Why is this news important?
Hong Kong is China’s most open financial gateway, and this time the HK$23 billion in subsidies is going directly toward asset tokenization. There are two deeper reasons behind this: first, Hong Kong wants to reduce its reliance on hot money from mainland China by attracting global assets through financial technology; second, Hong Kong’s relatively flexible regulatory environment allows it to explore ways to combine cryptocurrency with traditional finance. In short, the goal is to make Hong Kong a crypto vehicle for offshore renminbi. This means we may see more traditional financial institutions tokenizing assets through Hong Kong in the future.

Market impact
The impact on BTC and ETH is mostly psychological. On the one hand, having a developed economy like Hong Kong make asset tokenization a priority could boost market confidence—it’s more sustainable than relying solely on U.S. ETFs, after all. On the other hand, Hong Kong’s approach is more of a “start small and move fast” strategy, and it’s not yet on a scale that could change the global landscape. BNB Chain just confirmed on social media that a security risk exists in the Reth client, but immediately added that the risk doesn’t affect opBNB or BSC-Reth. The official team is working on a hotfix, and users don’t need to take any action for now. Why does this news matter?
The announcement is important because it effectively equates a potential security vulnerability with “no impact on the core network.” Reth is an important DeFi infrastructure component on BSC, so a security issue could theoretically affect all applications and users that depend on it. But BNB Chain’s statement amounts to reassurance for the market: they’re aware of the risk, and have contained its impact to a specific component (possibly op-reth). This reflects the BNB Chain team’s confidence in its network architecture and its ability to handle potential crises.

Market impact
In terms of market impact, this is a case of “good news amid bad news.” Although a security risk was indeed discovered, its actual impact has proven to be small, which in itself is positive for confidence in the network. It may not directly move major assets like ETH and BTC, but it’s a boost for DeFi activity on BSC and BNB Chain. It means BNB Chain is actively managing these risks rather than letting them suddenly surface and spook the market. By contrast, if this risk had been classified as a major vulnerability, it could have sparked broader concerns and even weighed on BSC’s TVL.

Trading perspective
This news is more likely to bolster confidence among existing bulls than to create a new buying opportunity. What exactly is the EVM, and what does “EVM-compatible” mean?
The EVM is a stack-based virtual machine. Each data unit (word) is 256 bits, and the stack has a maximum depth of 1024. EVM execution must be deterministic: the same input must produce the same result on every node, or the nodes cannot reach consensus.
“EVM-compatible” lets a project deploy the same contract across multiple chains, but it also means that the same types of contract vulnerabilities may exist on several chains at once.

Why does this news matter?
Texas data center policy is closely tied to AI development. First, for AI to take off, computing power has to keep up—and that requires data centers. Second, Texas is a major global data center hub, especially the Dallas area, where energy is cheap. If policy suddenly tightens, AI hardware costs could skyrocket. Now that the gubernatorial candidate has changed course, it’s like a shot in the arm for the AI computing supply chain. Lee is directly criticizing excessive market panic, indicating that he believes AI risks are being exaggerated. But uncertainty around Texas policy itself remains a variable.

Impact on the market
The path of impact on the crypto market is clear: softer data center policy → improved expectations for AI computing demand → increased demand for chips and servers → earnings from related hardware companies may exceed expectations → capital flows back into technology and hardware stocks → sentiment in the crypto market recovers. BTC and ETH have taken a beating recently, and now there’s a potential catalyst for the market to interpret. This could create room for a short-term sentiment recovery. A similar historical reference is Amazon’s major server price cuts in 2016: cloud computing stocks surged at the time, much like current expectations for AI computing demand.

In the short term, the market may respond positively to Lee’s view, but the extent will depend on how certain the implementation of Texas policy is. If it buys in, sentiment may recover in the short term—but don’t bet on policy becoming completely lenient.

📰 AI悲观论调到底被谁夸大了？得克萨斯数据中心政策给市场吃定心丸

Bitmine董事长Tom Lee不爽那些说AI风险天大的声音，直接怼回去：你们都被吓晕了！他还援引得州州长候选人新提议，说现在准许的数据中心项目都能继续干到2028年。这跟之前说要暂停新项目许可的提议完全反着来，现在政策又软了。Lee的意思是，那些说AI要搞垮市场的恐慌论调，纯属小题大做。

为什么这条新闻重要？
得州数据中心政策跟AI发展关系匪浅。第一，AI要火，必须算力跟上，算力靠啥？数据中心。第二，得州是全球数据中心重镇，特别是能源便宜的达拉斯地区。如果政策突然收紧，那AI硬件成本直接暴涨。现在州长候选人又改口了，相当于给AI算力供应链打了一针强心剂。Lee直接把矛头对准市场过度恐慌情绪，说明他认为AI风险被夸大，但得州政策不确定性本身就是个变量。

对市场的影响
对加密市场的影响路径很清晰：数据中心政策缓和→AI算力需求预期改善→芯片和服务器需求增加→相关硬件公司财报可能超预期→资金回流科技和硬件板块→加密市场情绪修复。BTC和ETH近期跌得够惨，现在有个潜在的催化剂要被市场解读，短期情绪修复空间可能就在这里。历史类似事件参考2016年亚马逊AWS大幅降低服务器价格，当时云计算股暴涨，跟现在AI算力需求预期很像。

操作思路
Lee认为AI悲观论调被夸大，但得州政策仍存在不确定性，如果州长竞选人最终政策更紧，这个逻辑作废。短期看，市场可能会对Lee观点作出正反馈，但幅度取决于得州政策落地确定性，如果选举结果影响市场解读，这个观点会失效。简单说：关注Lee观点被市场接受的程度，如果接受就短期情绪有修复，但别押注政策会彻底变松。
